_comment: Known critical/serious axe rule violations on the DuckDuckGo homepage, accepted as third-party issues we cannot fix. The accessibility test fails on any critical/serious rule NOT listed here. Remove an entry when upstream fixes it; add one only with a reason.

knownViolations.reason: Third-party markup references an invalid ARIA attribute value (observed 2026-11).
Third-party markup uses ARIA attributes prohibited on the element role (observed 2026-11).
Third-party marketing section has low-contrast text (observed 2026-11).
